opening.argument: The material presents a network-marketing business opportunity to students. Its description invites viewers to join, its title supplies a contact number, and the presentation says viewers can earn their own expenses without disturbing their studies. These are general claims about a business opportunity, not evidence of a deceptive transaction. The supplied material shows no deceptive payment flow, credential request, fabricated payout, or earnings relationship involving a recruitment hierarchy. The contact invitation and expense claim warrant scrutiny, but on this record they do not establish that viewers are being deceived or that any promised outcome occurred.
